# PCSpecialist Recoil IV launch audit — SRC-0367

The new live Belgian Recoil IV is materially separate from Recoil III. At check time its configurator fixed Core Ultra 9 290HX Plus, RTX 5090 24GB and the 2560x1600 300Hz Mini-LED/1250-nit/100% DCI-P3 display. PCSpecialist rates RTX 5090 at 150W plus 25W Dynamic Boost. The chassis specification lists aluminium, 2.8kg, 99Wh, 2.5GbE, separate DC-in, one TB4 plus one 10Gbps USB-C, three USB-A, HDMI 2.1, MiniDP 2.1a, SD, two SO-DIMM slots and two M.2 slots (Gen5 + Gen4). It has a glass touchpad and per-key RGB keyboard; Belgian ISO was selectable. Wi-Fi choices were Wi-Fi 6E rather than Wi-Fi 7.

Exact live route: 64GB Kingston DDR5-6400 CSODIMM, 2TB KLEVV C925G Gen4 SSD, Belgian keyboard, no operating system and included Gold warranty for **EUR 4232 incl. VAT/delivery**. The optional liquid cooler adds EUR 160, producing EUR 4392. A 64GB/1TB Samsung 9100 Pro route was EUR 4161; 64GB/2TB Samsung 9100 Pro was EUR 4457 and exceeded the ceiling.

Critical boundaries:

- PCSpecialist claims only up to five hours in UMA mode; no independent Recoil IV battery result exists.
- No independent exact-IV thermals, noise, sustained-power, touchpad, DPC, firmware or driver review was found at launch.
- Gold covers three years labor but only two years parts and collection. Platinum exists generally but was not selectable/priced for this basket.
- Exact display coating and ordinary Optimus/MSHybrid behavior remain UNKNOWN until exact documentation/review closes them.
